name: Sarume Uzume
source:
Uzume is the older sister of [url=/c39165]Shinonome[/url] and [url=/c39166]Len's[/url] childhood friend. She is the latest in the long line of white haired Sarume family members who bare the name and powers of Uzume. To maintain these powers, Uzume has been forced to live her entire life inside the sanctuary located in the village.

She has an almost unhealthy obsession towards Len whom she is madly in love with.

Normally she acts like a mature onee-sama to the other girls in the village, but when she sees Len, she starts acting like a little puppy who gets to see her master again.
